_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the first outcome's effect is 0.5 SD

agreement.claim: both engines report the same raw and adjusted p-values and rejection counts
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 in all 44 keys. harness/trials_examples.test.py rebuilds Holm and Benjamini-Hochberg by hand and shows unadjusted testing's family-wise error rate above 0.15 while Holm's is at most 0.1.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The recovery key is the first outcome's effect; the entry's claim is the error-rate control, asserted over the seeds. Measured by harness/trials_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
